title: Renovation of an Arcade Cabinet for the ESIG'TRONIX Association

information.value: 3 (carried out with two colleagues from the association)
Raspberry Pi 4 (4 GB) / RecallBox / Embedded Electronics / Customized LED Panel

description: The goal of this project was to modernize an arcade cabinet initially built in 2013-2014 by members of the ESIG'TRONIX association. The original cabinet used a Raspberry Pi 3 and offered a limited selection of retro games.

Together with two colleagues from the association, we undertook a complete upgrade of the arcade cabinet in June 2024. We replaced the Raspberry Pi 3 with a Raspberry Pi 4 with 4 GB of RAM, providing better performance for emulating multiple retro consoles.

The firmware was updated to RecallBox, allowing the integration of a wide range of retro consoles to enrich the gaming experience. The entire internal electronics were redesigned and refurbished to ensure better system stability and durability.

We also added an aesthetic touch by installing a customized LED panel on top of the cabinet, proudly displaying the ESIG'TRONIX association name, further strengthening our group's visual identity during events.
This project showcased our expertise in electronics, embedded computing, and customization of gaming systems, while providing a friendly entertainment space for the association's members.
